elements.label: Table 21
elements.title: Table 21: PPPs in Higher Education
elements.content:
| Phase in Life of University | Type of Partnership | Country Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Creation of new university | Public investment/private operation | Bangladesh, Malaysia, Morocco, Nigeria |
| Creation of new university | Private investment/public operation | China |
| Creation of new university | Split investment/public operation | Zambia |
| Development of existing public university | Private investment/public operation | United States |
| Development of existing public university | Private investment/private operation | France, United States |
| Regular operation of existing university | Shared facilities and services | Colombia |
| Regular operation of existing university | Private operation/public supervision | Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka |

Source: Elaborated by the authors.
